pages.text: Works as a room or as open ground. At least 27 blocks of space.$(p)Grants:$(li)Clear Sight, growing with the tier, up to +3.$(p)Tiers begin at a score of 5.

pages.text: None of this is required, but building it well earns more than the blocks alone:$(li)Sensor crowns the structure, within 1 of its highest layer, and dome encloses the room, and starlight sits over sensor.
